### Figure 3D closest neighborhoods to tumor nbhd
```{r}
results <- data.frame()

for (fov in unique(annots$PointNum)) {
  cat('Processing: ', fov, '\n')
  fov_data <- annots %>% dplyr::filter(PointNum == fov)
  pt_id <- fov_data$Patient[1]
  
  tumor_cells <- fov_data %>% dplyr::filter(CN == 'Tumor') %>% dplyr::select(Y_cent, X_cent)
  if (nrow(tumor_cells) == 0) next
  
  other_nbhds <- setdiff(unique(fov_data$CN), 'Tumor')
  
  for (nbhd in other_nbhds) {
    nbhd_cells <- fov_data %>% dplyr::filter(CN == nbhd) %>% dplyr::select(Y_cent, X_cent)
    
    dist_x <- outer(tumor_cells$X_cent, nbhd_cells$X_cent, "-")^2
    dist_y <- outer(tumor_cells$Y_cent, nbhd_cells$Y_cent, "-")^2
    distances <- sqrt(dist_x + dist_y)
    
    min_distances <- apply(distances, 1, min)
    
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      PointNum = fov,
      patient = pt_id,
      nbhd = nbhd,
      median_min_dist = median(min_distances),
      mean_min_dist = mean(min_distances)
    ))
  }
}

nbhd_summary <- results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(median_min_dist_um = 0.78 * median_min_dist) %>%
  group_by(nbhd) %>%
  summarise(median_dist = median(median_min_dist_um, na.rm = TRUE),
            q25 = quantile(median_min_dist_um, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
            q75 = quantile(median_min_dist_um, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n()) %>%
  arrange(median_dist)

p <- ggplot(nbhd_summary, aes(x = median_dist, y = reorder(nbhd, median_dist, decreasing = T))) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = q25, xmax = q75), height = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = nbhd), pch = 21, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = nbhd_palette) +
  labs(title = 'Distance from Tumor Cells to \nClosest Neighborhood Cells',
       x = 'Median Distance (um)',
       y = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill = 'none') +
  theme_bw()

ggsave('Figure3D.pdf', p, device = 'pdf', width = 4, height = 2)
```

### Figure 3E interface length
```{r}
library(deldir)

calculate_interface <- function(fov_id, data) {
  fov_data <- data %>% filter(PointNum == fov_id)
  patient_id <- fov_data$Patient[1]
  
  if(nrow(fov_data) < 10) return(NULL)
  
  all_points <- fov_data %>% select(X_cent, Y_cent, CN)
  if(nrow(all_points) < 4) return(NULL)
  
  all_points$point_id <- 1:nrow(all_points)
  
  # delaunay triangulation
  tri <- deldir(all_points$X_cent, all_points$Y_cent)
  edges <- tri$delsgs
  
  points_df <- data.frame(
    ind = 1:nrow(all_points),
    CN = all_points$CN
  )
  
  interface_counts <- data.frame()
  
  other_nbhds <- setdiff(unique(all_points$CN), 'Tumor')
  if(!('Tumor' %in% all_points$CN)) return(NULL)
  
  for(nbhd in other_nbhds) {
    interface_count <- 0
    
    for(i in 1:nrow(edges)) {
      ind1 <- edges$ind1[i]
      ind2 <- edges$ind2[i]
      
      type1 <- all_points$CN[ind1]
      type2 <- all_points$CN[ind2]
      
      if((type1 == 'Tumor' && type2 == nbhd) ||
         (type1 == nbhd && type2 == 'Tumor')) {
        interface_count <- interface_count + 1
      }
    }
    
    interface_counts <- rbind(interface_counts, 
                             data.frame(
                               PointNum = fov_id,
                               patient = patient_id,
                               nbhd = nbhd,
                               interface_count = interface_count
                             ))
  }
  
  # total number of tumor edges
  tumor_edges <- 0
  for(i in 1:nrow(edges)) {
    ind1 <- edges$ind1[i]
    ind2 <- edges$ind2[i]
    
    if(all_points$CN[ind1] == 'Tumor' || all_points$CN[ind2] == 'Tumor') {
      tumor_edges <- tumor_edges + 1
    }
  }
  
  # normalize by total number of tumor edges
  interface_counts$interface_ratio <- interface_counts$interface_count / max(tumor_edges, 1)
  
  return(interface_counts)
}

interface_results <- data.frame()

for(fov in unique(annots$PointNum)) {
  cat('Processing: ', fov, '\n')
  result <- calculate_interface(fov, annots)
  if(!is.null(result)) {
    interface_results <- rbind(interface_results, result)
  }
}

p <- ggplot(interface_results, aes(x = reorder(nbhd, interface_ratio, FUN = median, decreasing = T), y = interface_ratio, fill = nbhd)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = nbhd_palette) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.05, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = 'Tumor-Neighborhood Interface',
       x = element_blank(),
       y = 'Interface Proportion') +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = 'none',
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

ggsave('Figure3E.pdf', p, device = 'pdf', width = 4, height = 3)
```

### Figure 3F functional marker differences at tumor-nbhd boundary
```{r}
library(deldir)

functional_markers <- c('CD11b', 'CD15', 'CD16', 'MPO', 'CD45RA', 'CD45RO', 'HLA-DR', 'Ki67', 'PD-1', 'PD-L1')

analyze_interface_markers <- function(fov_id, data, functional_markers) {
  fov_data <- data %>% filter(PointNum == fov_id)
  
  if(nrow(fov_data) < 10) return(NULL)
  
  all_points <- fov_data %>% select(X_cent, Y_cent, CN)
  
  if(nrow(all_points) < 4) return(NULL)
  
  all_points$point_id <- 1:nrow(all_points)
  
  tri <- deldir(all_points$X_cent, all_points$Y_cent)
  
  edges <- tri$delsgs
  
  all_points_with_markers <- fov_data %>%
    mutate(point_id = 1:n()) %>%
    select(point_id, CN, all_of(functional_markers))
  
  interface_markers <- data.frame()
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(edges)) {
    ind1 <- edges$ind1[i]
    ind2 <- edges$ind2[i]
    
    type1 <- all_points$CN[ind1]
    type2 <- all_points$CN[ind2]
    
    if((type1 == 'Tumor' && type2 != 'Tumor') || 
       (type1 != 'Tumor' && type2 == 'Tumor')) {
      
      if(type1 != 'Tumor') {
        non_tumor_id <- ind1
        nbhd_type <- type1
      } else {
        non_tumor_id <- ind2
        nbhd_type <- type2
      }
      
      marker_values <- all_points_with_markers %>%
        filter(point_id == non_tumor_id) %>%
        select(all_of(functional_markers))
      
      interface_markers <- rbind(interface_markers, 
                               data.frame(
                                 PointNum = fov_id,
                                 patient = fov_data$Patient[1],
                                 nbhd = nbhd_type,
                                 marker_values,
                                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE
                               ))
    }
  }
  
  return(interface_markers)
}

interface_marker_results <- data.frame()

for(fov in unique(annots$PointNum)) {
  cat('Processing: ', fov, '\n')
  result <- analyze_interface_markers(fov, annots, functional_markers)
  if(!is.null(result)) {
    interface_marker_results <- rbind(interface_marker_results, result)
  }
}

interface_marker_results <- interface_marker_results %>%
  left_join(
    mdata %>% select(Patient, Relapse),
    by = c('patient' = 'Patient')
  )

immune_interfaces <- interface_marker_results %>%
  filter(nbhd %in% c('Immune Rich', 'Active Immune'))

functional_markers <- c('CD11b', 'CD15', 'CD16', 'MPO', 'CD45RA', 'CD45RO', 'HLA.DR', 'Ki67', 'PD.1', 'PD.L1')
immune_markers_long <- immune_interfaces %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(functional_markers),
               names_to = 'Marker',
               values_to = 'Expression')

p <- immune_markers_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Relapse = factor(Relapse, levels = c('Y', 'N'))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Relapse, y = Expression, fill = Relapse)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0) +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c('Y', 'N')), method = 'wilcox.test', label = 'p.signif') +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20))) +
    facet_grid(nbhd ~ Marker, scales = 'free_y') +
    scale_fill_manual(values = relapse_palette) +
    labs(title = 'Functional Marker Expression at Tumor-Immune Interfaces',
         x = 'Relapse Status',
         y = 'Expression') +
    theme_bw()

ggsave('Figure3F.pdf', p, device = 'pdf', width = 10, height = 3)
```
